findings.quote_a: Alongside these: an ADR or brief documenting purpose, help text with examples, a behave smoke test, and the GHI cited in the commit.
findings.quote_b: A GHI authorizes direct defect repair: `fix(<scope>): <summary> (GHI #N)`, closed with the commit SHA. Do not create an ADR or OBPI to discharge one.
findings.worked_example: A GHI repairs existing declared behavior by adding a recovery subcommand; no live brief owns the repair. Following the unconditional alongside list asks for ADR/brief authorship, whereas root and cli.md:73 direct a GHI repair without OBPI ceremony.
findings.winner: Root operator canon and cli.md:73 already settle direct-GHI routing. No runtime ceremony enforcement claimed.
